title: Print a specific column from a text file
summary: Use awk to extract and display a specific column (field) from a space-separated text file. You can also filter lines by content before printing.

steps.explain: Print the 5th column of a space-separated file. Change $5 to the column number you need.

alternatives.explain: Print the 2nd column only for lines containing a specific string.

placeholders.name: STRING
placeholders.description: Text to search for in the line

alternatives.explain: Print the last column of each line, using a comma as the field separator.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the CSV or comma-separated file
